title: Genome-scale CRISPR screen identifies TMEM41B as a critical host factor required for coronavirus replication [Focused cell]
model: PK-15-Cas9 porcine cells, focused 79-gene validation knockout library, TGEV survival selection
contrast: TGEV challenge round 3 (and round 5) vs unselected control library (1 vs 1, no replicates)
paper_method: MAGeCK; top candidates FUT8, TMEM41B, DYRK1A, MLST8
paper_calls: FUT8, TMEM41B, DYRK1A, MLST8 as top enriched candidates; TMEM41B and 4 others validated
barcs_calls: 3 genes at FDR 0.10 (FUT8, TMEM41B, MLST8), screening-level; counts recovered from normalized values
verdict: BARCS reproduces the paper's candidate order exactly (FUT8, TMEM41B, MLST8, DYRK1A) and calls the first three at FDR 0.10 from recovered counts, confirming TMEM41B as a strong TGEV host factor.
